manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {1} for each Forest Dryad.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling the Forest Dryads.
